The slight decrease in the current ratio indicates a slight worsening of the company's ability to meet its short-term obligations.  This suggests that company's current assets can only cover a little over 69% of the current liabilities.

While revenue has grown and operating income has improved, the reported net loss and decline in the current ratio are significant negatives.
